Name: Junimo Beacon
Author: Achtuur8
Description:
[b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b]

This mod lets you craft the [i]Junimo Beacon[/i], which extends the range of Junimo huts and adds extra Junimos to your hut based on how many beacons you have!

[size=4][b]How does it work?[/b][/size]

After you built your first Junimo Hut, the Wizard will send you a mail with the recipe containing the [i]Junimo Beacon[/i], and you will be able to craft the beacon using Starfruit, fiber and clay. When you hold a statue on the farm, you will see the range of all Junimo huts on the farm and the range of your statue. When you place a statue in range of a hut, it will connect to the hut and show it with a small particle. Junimo's from that hut can now also harvest crops in range of the statue, and you get extra Junimo's from that hut, up to a maximum of 5.

Is it possible to have more than 5 Junimo per hut? Technically, yes, but in practice it's a bit finnicky. When you have too many Junimo, they tend to instantly despawn, as there is "nothing to do", since other Junimo are already harvesting the crops. I found that 5 Junimo is about where new Junimo still tend to do things without instantly despawning.

[size=4][b]How do I know it's working?[/b][/size]

If the mod installed sucessfully, you should receive a mail from the Wizard the day after building your first Junimo hut. Holding a Junimo statue on the farm should show the range of the Junimo huts on the farm, and also of the beacon you are holding. You should also see more Junimo than usual after placing the statue.[b] Note that it is possible[/b] that the extra Junimo only spawn the next day after placing the statue.
